  --txt:#f6e6d4; --dim:#d8ad84;
  --panel:rgba(32,18,10,0.92); --panel2:rgba(46,26,14,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.26); --glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.42);
  --bg0:#1a0e06;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(60,32,16,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(232,150,80,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(226,130,60,0.30);
}
#tc-root[data-theme="forest"] {
  --a-hi:#d6f8c2; --a-1:#6fcb5b; --a-2:#3d9a3f; --a-3:#215a27;
  --txt:#eaf6dd; --dim:#aecb96;
  --panel:rgba(12,28,14,0.92); --panel2:rgba(16,40,20,0.92);
  --bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.26); --glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.42);
  --bg0:#07160a;
  --tc-card-bg:rgba(20,52,24,0.74); --tc-card-bord:rgba(140,220,120,0.42); --tc-card-glow:rgba(110,210,90,0.30);
}
.tc-te-label { font: 600 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 7px; }
.tc-te-bgrow { margin-bottom: 13px; }
.tc-te-bgs { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-bgopt { width: 96px; height: 54px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid var(--bord); background-size: cover; background-position: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: border-color var(--tc-fast), transform var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-bgopt:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--a-2); }
.tc-bgopt.sel { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1); }
#tc-gui-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; background-repeat: no-repeat; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .45s var(--tc-ease); pointer-events: none; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui-img { opacity: 1; }
#tc-root[data-theme="frost"] #tc-gui { background: rgba(6,16,28,0.34); }
#tc-gui-bg { z-index: 1; }
#tc-gui-panel { z-index: 2; }
.tc-titletext { -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; }
.tc-theme-hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--dim); margin: 2px 2px 13px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tc-themes-head { margin: 0 2px 14px; }
.tc-themes-h1 { font: 700 15px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); letter-spacing: .01em; }
.tc-themes-sub { font: 500 11.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--dim); margin-top: 3px; }
.tc-themes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(156px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.tc-theme { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background: var(--panel2); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; transition: transform var(--tc-fast), border-color var(--tc-fast), box-shadow var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--a-2); box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-thumb { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-position: center; background-size: cover; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-foot { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.80)); }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-name { font: 700 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.tc-theme .tc-theme-tag { margin-left: auto; font: 700 10px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-theme.selected { border-color: var(--a-1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--a-1), 0 10px 26px -14px var(--glow); }
.tc-theme.selected .tc-theme-tag { opacity: 1; }
.tc-title-editor { display: none; margin: 0 0 15px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel2); }
.tc-title-editor.open { display: block; animation: tcFade var(--tc-med) var(--tc-ease); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head { font: 600 12.5px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); margin-bottom: 9px; }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-head b { color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor input { width: 100%; font: 500 13px 'Outfit', sans-serif; color: var(--txt); background: var(--bg0); border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; outline: none; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.tc-title-editor input:focus { border-color: var(--a-1); }
.tc-title-editor .tc-te-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tc-te-btns button { font: 600 12px 'Outfit', sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--bord); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter var(--tc-fast); }
.tc-te-btns button:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); }
.tc-te-save { color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2)); border-color: transparent; }
.tc-te-reset, .tc-te-cancel { color: var(--dim); background: transparent; }

      st.textContent = TC_ROOT_CSS;
      (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(st);

  function ensureRoot() {
    ensureStyle();
    var el = document.getElementById('tc-root');
    if (!el) {
      try {
        var holder = document.createElement('div');
        holder.innerHTML = TC_ROOT_HTML;
        el = holder.firstElementChild;
        if (el) document.documentElement.appendChild(el);
      } catch (e) { console.error('[TreasureClient] could not build overlay:', e); }
    }
    return document.getElementById('tc-root');
  }
  function relocateAndBoot() {
    try {
      var el = ensureRoot();
      if (el && el.parentNode !== document.documentElement) {
        document.documentElement.appendChild(el); // move out of <body> so the engine can't wipe it
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    try { init(); } catch (e) { console.error('[TreasureClient] overlay init failed (game unaffected):', e); }
    // Watchdog: if the engine (or anything) detaches our overlay, put it back.
    try {
      setInterval(function () {
        var el = document.getElementById('tc-root');
        if (!el) { el = ensureRoot(); }  // rebuild if the bundler/engine removed it
        if (el && !document.documentElement.contains(el)) {
          try { document.documentElement.appendChild(el); } catch (e) {}
        }
      }, 1000);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function boot() { relocateAndBoot(); }
  if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') setTimeout(boot, 0);
  else window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  // Also try again after full load, since the engine boots on window 'load'
  // and clears <body> then — this guarantees we end up on top afterward.
  window.addEventListener('load', function () { setTimeout(relocateAndBoot, 1200); });

  function init() {
    var root = document.getElementById('tc-root');
    if (!root) return;
    if (root.__tcInited) return; // don't double-initialize when called again after load
    root.__tcInited = true;

    // ---- Theme system (Themes tab). Expandable: add an entry and it appears. ----
    var TC_FROST_BG = "data:image/avif;base64,";
    var TC_TROPICAL_BG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
    var TC_TERRACOTTA_BG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
    var TC_FOREST_BG_2 = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
    var TC_TREASURE_BG = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
    var TC_THEMES = [
      { id:'normal', name:'Treasure', title:'Treasure Client', bg:TC_TREASURE_BG, weather:false },
      { id:'frost',  name:'Frost',    title:'Treasure Client', bg:TC_FROST_BG, weather:true  },
      { id:'tropical', name:'Tropical', title:'Treasure Client', bg:TC_TROPICAL_BG, weather:false },
      { id:'terracotta', name:'Terracotta', title:'Treasure Client', bg:TC_TERRACOTTA_BG, weather:false },
      { id:'forest', name:'Forest', title:'Treasure Client', bg:TC_FOREST_BG_2, weather:false }
    ];
    function tcTheme(id){ for (var i=0;i<TC_THEMES.length;i++){ if (TC_THEMES[i].id===id) return TC_THEMES[i]; } return TC_THEMES[0]; }

    var LS = 'treasureClient.settings';
    var defaults = {
      mode:'normal', menuKeyCode:'ShiftRight', menuKeyLabel:'Right Shift',
      crosshair:false, crosshairStyle:'cross', crosshairSize:22, crosshairThickness:2, crosshairGap:3, crosshairColor:'theme', crosshairOpacity:100, guiAnim:true,
      keystrokes:false, ksShowMouse:'1', cps:false, fps:false, hudPos:'left', fullbright:false,
      toggleSprint:false, toggleSneak:false, sprintMode:'always',
      sprintToggleKeyCode:null, sprintToggleKeyLabel:'Unbound',
      sneakToggleKeyCode:null, sneakToggleKeyLabel:'Unbound',
      // new HUD mods — all backed by real, live game state (see TreasureHud.java bridge)
      coords:false, coordPrecision:'1', direction:false, dirMode:'cardinal', ping:false,
      armorStatus:false, potionEffects:false, heldItem:false, fpsGraph:false, perfMonitor:false, sprintStatus:false, sneakStatus:false,
      // hitboxes — visual-only, uses vanilla's own F3+B renderer (see TreasureMods.java)
      hitboxes:false, hitboxPlayers:true, hitboxMobs:true, hitboxAnimals:true, hitboxOther:false,
      noParticles:false, noHurtCam:false, tntTimer:false,
      pauseUnfocused:false,
      zoom:false, zoomLevel:30, zoomKeyCode:'KeyC', zoomKeyLabel:'C', smoothZoom:false, zoomSpeed:8,
      resolutionScale:100,
      theme:'normal', themeTitles:{}, themeBg:{},
      hudPositions:{}
    };
    var state = load();
    function load() {
      try { var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS)); s = Object.assign({}, defaults, s || {}); }
      catch (e) { var s = Object.assign({}, defaults); }
      // Sync mode with the Java main menu, which stores it at
      // localStorage["_eaglercraft_1.12.tcmode"] (Base64 of one byte: 1=deep sea).
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcmode');
        if (raw) { var by = atob(raw); if (by.length > 0) s.mode = (by.charCodeAt(0) === 1) ? 'deep' : 'normal'; }
      } catch (e) {}
      return s;
    }
    // Write our mode back to the shared key so the Java menu agrees.
    function syncModeToEngine() { /* Deep Sea mode removed — no-op */ }

    // FPS Booster toggle: write the tcfps flag the Java side reads (it applies the
    // lean video settings + restores them when off), and show a brief loading
    // screen while the world rebuilds.
    function save() { try { localStorage.setItem(LS, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) {} }

    /* ============================================================
       REAL performance control.
       The engine reads its graphics options from
       localStorage["_eaglercraft_1.12.g"] — a Base64'd plain-text
       options file (renderDistance:N, particles:N, fancyGraphics:
       true/false, ao:0|2, renderClouds:true/false/fast, maxFps:N,
       fov:F ...). We merge our performance profile into whatever
       options already exist, so switching modes genuinely changes
       how the game renders on the NEXT world load — same mechanism
       the in-game Video Settings screen uses, just driven by us.
       ============================================================ */
    var OPT_KEY = '_eaglercraft_1.12.g';
    // per-mode + experimental performance profiles (only keys we set are touched)
    function perfProfile() {
      var deep = state.mode === 'deep';
      var prof;
      if (!deep) {
        // Normal: balanced, good-looking. Never forced laggy.
        prof = { renderDistance: 8, particles: 0, fancyGraphics: 'true', ao: '2', renderClouds: 'true', maxFps: '260', bobView: 'true', entityShadows: 'true', mipmapLevels: '4' };
      } else {
        // Deep Sea: experimental performance path. Aggressive but playable.
        prof = { renderDistance: 5, particles: 1, fancyGraphics: 'false', ao: '0', renderClouds: 'false', maxFps: '260', bobView: 'true', entityShadows: 'false', mipmapLevels: '0' };
        if (state.expChunks)   prof.renderDistance = 3;         // ultra-short render distance
        if (state.expNoParticles) prof.particles = 2;           // particles: minimal
        if (state.expNoClouds) prof.renderClouds = 'false';
        if (state.expNoBob)    prof.bobView = 'false';
        if (state.expFov)      prof.fov = '0.75';               // wider FOV, feels faster (0..1 -> 70..110)
      }
      // Fullbright: drive the engine's gamma very high (works in both modes).
      if (state.fullbright) prof.gamma = '1000.0';
      else prof.gamma = '1.0';
      return prof;
    }
    function b64encodeStr(str) {
      var bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(str), bin = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
      return btoa(bin);
    }
    function b64decodeStr(b64) {
      try { var bin = atob(b64); var bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length); for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i); return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); }
      catch (e) { return ''; }
    }
    // Treasure Client no longer overrides the game's video options (render
    // distance, particles, graphics, clouds, FOV, framerate cap…) — those are
    // the game's own Video Settings and it was wrong to silently rewrite them.
    // The ONLY engine option we still drive is Fullbright, which has no in-game
    // equivalent: it pushes gamma very high (and restores it to normal when off).
    function applyFullbrightToEngine() {
      try {
        var existing = localStorage.getItem(OPT_KEY);
        var lines = existing ? b64decodeStr(existing).split('\n') : [];
        var map = {};
        lines.forEach(function (ln) { var i = ln.indexOf(':'); if (i > 0) map[ln.substring(0, i)] = ln.substring(i + 1); });
        if (!map['version']) map['version'] = '1343';
        map['gamma'] = state.fullbright ? '1000.0' : '1.0';
        var out = Object.keys(map).map(function (k) { return k + ':' + map[k]; }).join('\n') + '\n';
        localStorage.setItem(OPT_KEY, b64encodeStr(out));
        return true;
      } catch (e) { return false; }
    }
    // kept as an alias so existing call sites keep working, but it now ONLY
    // applies Fullbright — nothing else.
    function applyPerfToEngine() { return applyFullbrightToEngine(); }

    /* ============================================================
       Toggle Sprint / Toggle Sneak are now handled by the NATIVE
       Java module (TreasureMods.java) which sets the real keybind
       state each tick — reliable, and can't trip our own hotkey.
       Here we just persist the flags to the storage key the Java
       side reads: localStorage["_eaglercraft_1.12.tcmods"], a plain
       "k=v,k=v" string.
       ============================================================ */
    function writeModsToEngine() {
      try {
        var parts = [
          'sprint=' + (state.toggleSprint ? 1 : 0),
          'sprintMode=' + (state.sprintMode === 'doubletap' ? 1 : 0),
          'sneak=' + (state.toggleSneak ? 1 : 0),
          'hitbox=' + (state.hitboxes ? 1 : 0),
          'hbPlayers=' + (state.hitboxPlayers ? 1 : 0),
          'hbMobs=' + (state.hitboxMobs ? 1 : 0),
          'hbAnimals=' + (state.hitboxAnimals ? 1 : 0),
          'hbOther=' + (state.hitboxOther ? 1 : 0),
          'pauseUnfocused=' + (state.pauseUnfocused ? 1 : 0),
          'zoomLevel=' + (state.zoomLevel || 30),
          'smoothZoom=' + (state.smoothZoom ? 1 : 0),
          'zoomSpeed=' + (state.zoomSpeed || 8),
          'noParticles=' + (state.noParticles ? 1 : 0),
          'noHurtCam=' + (state.noHurtCam ? 1 : 0),
          'tntTimer=' + (state.tntTimer ? 1 : 0),
          'via=' + (state.via === false ? 0 : 1),
          'pwHide=' + (state.pwHide ? 1 : 0),
          'lowFire=' + (state.lowFire ? 1 : 0),
          'lowFireH=' + (state.lowFireH || 40),
          'lowShield=' + (state.lowShield ? 1 : 0),
          'lowShieldA=' + (state.lowShieldA || 30),
          'smallTotem=' + (state.smallTotem ? 1 : 0),
          'totemScale=' + (state.totemScale || 40)
        ];
        localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcmods', btoa(parts.join(',')));
      } catch (e) {}
    }


    /* ---------- element refs ---------- */
    var gui = document.getElementById('tc-gui');
    var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || root).querySelector(s); };
    var $$ = function (s, r) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || root).querySelectorAll(s)); };

    /* ---------- theme / mode ---------- */
    function applyMode() { applyTheme(state.theme || 'normal'); }
    // (mode toggle buttons removed — no click handlers needed)

    /* ---------- external open request ----------
       The Java main menu "Mod Menu" button sets tcopen=1 to ask us to open. */
    function pollSharedMode() {
      // Java main menu "Mod Menu" button sets tcopen=1 to ask us to open. This is
      // the always-available way in, so an unbound hotkey can never lock you out.
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcopen');
        if (raw) {
          var by = atob(raw);
          if (by.length > 0 && by.charCodeAt(0) === 1) {
            localStorage.removeItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcopen');
            if (!gui.classList.contains('open')) openGui();
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function flashPerfNote() {
      var n = $('#tc-perf-note');
      if (!n) return;
      n.textContent = 'Saved. Click “Apply & Reload” to see the new framerate now.';
      clearTimeout(flashPerfNote._t);
      flashPerfNote._t = setTimeout(function () { n.textContent = ''; }, 5000);
    }

    /* ---------- open / close ---------- */
    function openGui() {
      gui.classList.add('open'); root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false'); if (root.__tcBgStart) root.__tcBgStart(); tcRefreshMenuBg();
      try { if (typeof tcSetView === 'function') tcSetView('modules'); } catch (e) {}
      // Ask the Java side to open the in-game menu so the world pauses (SP) and
      // the mouse is freed — no more needing to press Escape after the hotkey.
      try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcpause', btoa(String.fromCharCode(1))); } catch (e) {}
      // Also release pointer lock immediately so the cursor is usable right away.
      try { if (document.exitPointerLock) document.exitPointerLock(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function closeGui() {
      if (typeof bindListening !== 'undefined' && bindListening) {
        bindListening = null;
        $$('.tc-keybind.listening').forEach(function (o) { o.classList.remove('listening'); });
        if (typeof refreshBindButtons === 'function') refreshBindButtons();
      }
      gui.classList.remove('open'); root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); if (root.__tcBgStop) root.__tcBgStop(); tcRefreshMenuBg();
      // Ask Java to close the in-game menu we opened (return to the world).
      try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcpause', btoa(String.fromCharCode(2))); } catch (e) {}
      if (typeof window.__tcRefocusGame === 'function') window.__tcRefocusGame();
    }
    function toggleGui() { gui.classList.contains('open') ? closeGui() : openGui(); }
    // Treasure Client: persistent bottom-right watermark (all screens), and push
    // the current mod flags (incl. ViaVersion default-on) to the Java bridge now.
    (function () {
      try {
        var wm = document.getElementById('tc-watermark');
        if (!wm) {
          wm = document.createElement('div');
          wm.id = 'tc-watermark';
          wm.textContent = 'Treasure Client 1.2';
          wm.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:6px;bottom:4px;z-index:2147483647;'
            + 'pointer-events:none;font:600 11px/1.2 system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;'
            + 'color:rgba(255,255,255,0.72);text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);'
            + 'letter-spacing:.3px;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;';
          (document.body || document.documentElement).appendChild(wm);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try { writeModsToEngine(); } catch (e) {}
    })();
    $('#tc-close').addEventListener('click', closeGui);
    $('#tc-done').addEventListener('click', closeGui);
    gui.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { if (e.target === gui) closeGui(); });

    /* ---------- category tabs ---------- */
    $$('.tc-cat').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        $$('.tc-cat').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
        btn.classList.add('active');
        var cat = btn.dataset.cat;
        $$('.tc-panel').forEach(function (p) {
          var show = (cat === 'all') || (p.dataset.group === cat);
          p.classList.toggle('active', show);
        });
      });
    });
    (function () { var allBtn = $('.tc-cat[data-cat="all"]'); if (allBtn) allBtn.click(); })();

    /* ---------- side view tabs: Modules / HUD Editor / Themes ---------- */
    function tcSetView(view) {
      try {
        var body = $('#tc-body');
        if (body) { body.classList.remove('tcv-modules', 'tcv-hud', 'tcv-themes'); body.classList.add('tcv-' + view); }
        $$('.tc-view').forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view === view); });
        if (view === 'hud') {
          var eb = $('#tc-hud-edit'); if (eb) eb.click(); // open the HUD drag editor (closes the menu)
        } else if (view === 'modules') {
          var a = $('#tc-catbar .tc-cat.active') || $('#tc-catbar .tc-cat[data-cat="all"]');
          if (a) a.click();
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    $$('.tc-view').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { tcSetView(b.dataset.view); }); });
    tcSetView('modules');

    /* ---------- toggles / selects / sliders ---------- */
    $$('.tc-sw[data-mod]').forEach(function (sw) {
      var key = sw.dataset.mod;
      if (state[key]) sw.classList.add('on');
      sw.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var on = !sw.classList.contains('on');
        sw.classList.toggle('on', on);
        state[key] = on; save();
        if (key === 'fullbright') { applyFullbrightToEngine(); showModFlash('Fullbright ' + (state.fullbright ? 'ON' : 'OFF') + ' — reload to apply'); }
        else if (key === 'toggleSprint' || key === 'toggleSneak' || key.indexOf('hitbox') === 0 || key === 'pauseUnfocused' || key === 'zoom' || key === 'noParticles' || key === 'noHurtCam' || key === 'tntTimer' || key === 'smoothZoom' || key === 'via' || key === 'pwHide' || key === 'lowFire' || key === 'lowShield' || key === 'smallTotem') { writeModsToEngine(); }
        else applyHud();
      });
    });
    $$('select[data-mod]').forEach(function (sel) {
      var key = sel.dataset.mod;
      if (state[key] != null) sel.value = state[key];
      sel.addEventListener('change', function () { if (!sel.dataset.pending) { state[key] = sel.value; save(); applyHud(); } });
    });
    // sliders now persist to state and re-apply the HUD live (crosshair size/thickness/opacity)
    $$('input[type="range"][data-mod]').forEach(function (sl) {
      var key = sl.dataset.mod;
      var out = sl.parentNode.querySelector('.tc-val');
      if (state[key] != null) sl.value = state[key];
      if (out) out.textContent = sl.value;
      sl.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (out) out.textContent = sl.value;
        state[key] = parseInt(sl.value, 10); save();
        if (key === 'zoomLevel' || key === 'zoomSpeed' || key === 'lowFireH' || key === 'lowShieldA' || key === 'totemScale') writeModsToEngine(); // engine-backed sliders
        else if (key === 'resolutionScale') applyResolutionScale();
        else applyHud();
      });
    });

    /* ---------- per-mod settings: gear expanders + segmented controls ---------- */
    /* ---------- mod settings sub-page ---------- */
    var guiPanel = $('#tc-gui-panel'), subPage = $('#tc-subpage'),
        subTitle = $('#tc-subpage-title'), subBody = $('#tc-subpage-body'),
        subBack = $('#tc-subback');
    var subReturnCfg = null;
    function openSubPage(gearKey, modName) {
      var cfg = $('.tc-cfg[data-cfg="' + gearKey + '"]');
      if (!cfg) return;
      subReturnCfg = { node: cfg, parent: cfg.parentNode, next: cfg.nextSibling };
      subTitle.textContent = modName || 'Settings';
      subBody.appendChild(cfg);
      cfg.classList.add('open');
      guiPanel.classList.add('tc-showsub');
    }
    function closeSubPage() {
      if (subReturnCfg) {
        subReturnCfg.node.classList.remove('open');
        subReturnCfg.parent.insertBefore(subReturnCfg.node, subReturnCfg.next);
        subReturnCfg = null;
      }
      guiPanel.classList.remove('tc-showsub');
    }
    subBack.addEventListener('click', closeSubPage);
    $$('.tc-gear[data-gear]').forEach(function (g) {
      var row = g.closest('.tc-row');
      var nameEl = row ? row.querySelector('.tc-lab b') : null;
      var modName = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent : 'Settings';
      g.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); openSubPage(g.dataset.gear, modName); });
      var box = g.closest('.tc-mod');
      if (box) {
        box.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); openSubPage(g.dataset.gear, modName); });
      }
    });
    $$('.tc-seg[data-seg]').forEach(function (seg) {
      var key = seg.dataset.seg;
      $$('button', seg).forEach(function (b) {
        b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.val === String(state[key]));
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
          state[key] = b.dataset.val;
          $$('button', seg).forEach(function (x) { x.classList.toggle('on', x === b); });
          save();
          writeModsToEngine(); // sprintMode lives in the Java bridge
          applyHud();          // ksShowMouse / coordPrecision / dirMode are HUD-side
        });
      });
    });

    /* ---------- search across mods / settings / categories ---------- */
    (function () {
      var input = $('#tc-search'), body = $('#tc-body');
      if (!input || !body) return;
      // The Eaglercraft engine attaches its own key listeners high up (document/
      // window) and will happily swallow keystrokes meant for this search box.
      // Stop key events from propagating OUT of the input to the engine, but let
      // the input handle them itself. stopImmediatePropagation on the element in
      // the bubble phase keeps the character in the box and away from the game.
      ['keydown', 'keyup', 'keypress'].forEach(function (evt) {
        input.addEventListener(evt, function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, false);
      });
      // Make sure a click really focuses it (the engine can steal focus/pointer).
      input.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
      input.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); try { input.focus(); } catch (x) {} }, false);
      // Build a search index: every .tc-mod / .tc-row gets a haystack from its
      // labels, and each panel's category name is attached too.
      var items = [];
      $$('.tc-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
        var cat = panel.dataset.panel || '';
        $$('.tc-mod, .tc-row, .tc-kb-row', panel).forEach(function (el) {
          if (el.closest('.tc-cfg')) return; // config sub-rows follow their parent
          if (el.classList.contains('tc-mod') && el.querySelector('.tc-row, .tc-kb-row') && el.parentNode && el.parentNode.classList.contains('tc-mod')) return;
          var text = (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase();
          items.push({ el: el, panel: panel, hay: text + ' ' + cat });
        });
      });
      function clearSearch() {
        body.classList.remove('searching');
        $$('.tc-panel').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.remove('tc-search-hit'); });
        items.forEach(function (it) { it.el.removeAttribute('data-searchmiss'); });
        var empty = $('#tc-search-empty'); if (empty) empty.remove();
      }
      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        var q = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!q) { clearSearch(); return; }
        body.classList.add('searching');
        var hitPanels = {};
        var any = false;
        items.forEach(function (it) {
          var hit = it.hay.indexOf(q) !== -1;
          it.el.toggleAttribute('data-searchmiss', !hit);
          if (hit) { hitPanels[it.panel.dataset.panel] = it.panel; any = true; }
        });
        $$('.tc-panel').forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle('tc-search-hit', !!hitPanels[p.dataset.panel]); });
        var empty = $('#tc-search-empty');
        if (!any) {
          if (!empty) { empty = document.createElement('div'); empty.id = 'tc-search-empty'; empty.className = 'tc-search-empty'; $('.tc-panels').appendChild(empty); }
          empty.textContent = 'No mods match “' + input.value.trim() + '”.';
        } else if (empty) { empty.remove(); }
      });
      // clear the search when a category is clicked
      $$('.tc-cat').forEach(function (c) { c.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = ''; clearSearch(); }); });
    })();

    /* ---------- HUD application ---------- */
    var crosshair = $('#tc-crosshair'), keystrokes = $('#tc-keystrokes'), cpsEl = $('#tc-cps'), fpsEl = $('#tc-fps');
    var coordsEl = $('#tc-coords'), dirEl = $('#tc-direction'), pingEl = $('#tc-ping'),
        armorEl = $('#tc-armor'), potionsEl = $('#tc-potions'), heldEl = $('#tc-helditem'),
        fpsGraphEl = $('#tc-fpsgraph'), perfMonEl = $('#tc-perfmon'), sprintEl = $('#tc-sprint'), sneakEl = $('#tc-sneak');
    function crosshairShouldShow() {
      // Only during actual gameplay (pointer locked to the canvas), never on menus.
      var locked = !!(document.pointerLockElement || document.mozPointerLockElement || document.webkitPointerLockElement);
      return state.crosshair && locked;
    }
    function crosshairColorVal() {
      // 'theme' follows the active mode accent; others are fixed colors
      switch (state.crosshairColor) {
        case 'white': return '#ffffff';
        case 'red': return '#ff5555';
        case 'green': return '#55ff55';
        case 'cyan': return '#55ffff';
        case 'black': return '#000000';
        default: return getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--a-1').trim() || '#ffd76b';
      }
    }
    function applyResolutionScale() {
      // Write the render-resolution scale that the WASM platform layer reads when
      // it sizes the framebuffer. 100 = native, lower = fewer pixels = higher FPS.
      try {
        var v = Math.max(30, Math.min(100, parseInt(state.resolutionScale, 10) || 100));
        localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcres', btoa(String(v)));
        // Fire a resize so the engine recomputes its framebuffer size immediately
        // (reportWindowSize only runs on resize) — makes the slider apply live.
        try { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); } catch (e) {}
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function applyCrosshairStyle() {
      // size / thickness / gap / opacity / color all driven by settings
      var s = state.crosshairSize || 22, t = state.crosshairThickness || 2,
          o = (state.crosshairOpacity == null ? 100 : state.crosshairOpacity) / 100,
          gap = (state.crosshairGap == null ? 3 : state.crosshairGap),
          col = crosshairColorVal();
      crosshair.style.width = s + 'px'; crosshair.style.height = s + 'px'; crosshair.style.opacity = o;
      // arm length shrinks as gap grows so the crosshair stays within its box
      var arm = Math.max(3, Math.round(s * 0.36) - gap);
      if (state.crosshairStyle === 'dot') {
        crosshair.style.background = col; crosshair.style.width = Math.max(3, t + 2) + 'px'; crosshair.style.height = Math.max(3, t + 2) + 'px'; crosshair.style.borderRadius = '50%';
      } else if (state.crosshairStyle === 'tshape') {
        crosshair.style.borderRadius = '0';
        crosshair.style.background =
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 50% 100%/' + t + 'px ' + arm + 'px no-repeat,' +
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 0 50%/' + arm + 'px ' + t + 'px no-repeat,' +
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 100% 50%/' + arm + 'px ' + t + 'px no-repeat';
      } else {
        crosshair.style.borderRadius = '0';
        crosshair.style.background =
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 50% 0/' + t + 'px ' + arm + 'px no-repeat,' +
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 50% 100%/' + t + 'px ' + arm + 'px no-repeat,' +
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 0 50%/' + arm + 'px ' + t + 'px no-repeat,' +
          'linear-gradient(' + col + ',' + col + ') 100% 50%/' + arm + 'px ' + t + 'px no-repeat';
      }
    }
    function applyHud() {
      root.classList.toggle('hud-right', state.hudPos === 'right');
      if (crosshairShouldShow()) { crosshair.classList.remove('tc-hidden'); applyCrosshairStyle(); }
      else { crosshair.classList.add('tc-hidden'); }
      keystrokes.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.keystrokes);
      // keystrokes: hide mouse+space rows when ksShowMouse is off
      var showMouse = String(state.ksShowMouse) !== '0';
      $$('#tc-keystrokes .tc-ks-row').forEach(function (row, idx) {
        // rows: 0=W, 1=ASD, 2=LMB/RMB, 3=SPACE
        if (idx >= 2) row.style.display = showMouse ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
      cpsEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.cps);
      fpsEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.fps);
      coordsEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.coords);
      dirEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.direction);
      pingEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.ping);
      armorEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.armorStatus);
      potionsEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.potionEffects);
      heldEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.heldItem);
      fpsGraphEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.fpsGraph);
      perfMonEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.perfMonitor);
      sprintEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.sprintStatus);
      sneakEl.classList.toggle('tc-hidden', !state.sneakStatus);
      applyHudPositions();
    }
    // re-evaluate crosshair whenever pointer-lock changes (entering/leaving gameplay)
    ['pointerlockchange','mozpointerlockchange','webkitpointerlockchange'].forEach(function (ev) {
      document.addEventListener(ev, applyHud, false);
    });

    /* ---------- custom HUD positions (persisted; applied over CSS defaults) ---------- */
    var HUD_ELS = ['tc-coords','tc-direction','tc-ping','tc-armor','tc-potions','tc-helditem','tc-fpsgraph','tc-perfmon','tc-keystrokes','tc-cps','tc-fps'];
    function applyHudPositions() {
      HUD_ELS.forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return;
        var p = state.hudPositions && state.hudPositions[id];
        if (p && typeof p.left === 'number' && typeof p.top === 'number') {
          el.style.left = p.left + 'px'; el.style.top = p.top + 'px';
          el.style.right = 'auto'; el.style.bottom = 'auto'; el.style.transform = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    // Hide every in-game HUD element on the main menu / when not in a world.
    // Keystrokes, CPS, FPS, coords, etc. are gameplay overlays — they should only
    // appear once you're actually in a world (hud.active), never on the main menu.
    // The layout editor is the one exception: it force-shows enabled elements so
    // you can position them.
    function applyHudVisibility() {
      var editing = root.classList.contains('hud-editing');
      var show = hud.active || editing;
      root.classList.toggle('tc-nogame', !show);
    }
    var keyEls = {};
    $$('#tc-keystrokes span[data-key]').forEach(function (el) { keyEls[el.dataset.key] = el; });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (keyEls[e.code]) keyEls[e.code].classList.add('down'); });
    window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { if (keyEls[e.code]) keyEls[e.code].classList.remove('down'); });

    /* ---------- Zoom (hold key) — drives the Java FOV multiplier via tczoom ---------- */
    // Only zooms during actual gameplay (pointer locked, GUI closed) and only if
    // the Zoom mod is enabled. Writing tczoom=1/0 is read by EntityRenderer.
    var zoomHeld = false;
    function zoomInGameplay() {
      // In-game (hud.active from the Java bridge) with the menu closed. We key off
      // the game bridge rather than pointer-lock, which is more reliable across
      // browsers and matches when the FOV zoom is actually useful.
      return state.zoom && hud.active && !gui.classList.contains('open');
    }
    function setZoom(on) {
      if (on === zoomHeld) return;
      zoomHeld = on;
      try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tczoom', btoa(String.fromCharCode(on ? 1 : 0))); } catch (e) {}
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (bindListening) return; // don't zoom while rebinding
      if (state.zoomKeyCode && e.code === state.zoomKeyCode && zoomInGameplay()) { setZoom(true); }
    }, true);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
      if (state.zoomKeyCode && e.code === state.zoomKeyCode) { setZoom(false); }
    }, true);
    // safety: drop zoom if the window blurs or the menu opens
    window.addEventListener('blur', function () { setZoom(false); });

    /* ---------- CPS + mouse keystrokes (real: press & release, both buttons) ---------- */
    var clicks = [];
    // Track true press/held/release for LMB & RMB so the keystrokes HUD lights up
    // while a button is held (not just a 90ms blink), and CPS counts left clicks.
    // Capture phase + both window and document so it still registers while the
    // engine has pointer lock during gameplay.
    function mouseDown(e) {
      if (e.button === 0) { clicks.push(performance.now()); if (keyEls['MouseL']) keyEls['MouseL'].classList.add('down'); }
      if (e.button === 2 && keyEls['MouseR']) keyEls['MouseR'].classList.add('down');
    }
    function mouseUp(e) {
      if (e.button === 0 && keyEls['MouseL']) keyEls['MouseL'].classList.remove('down');
      if (e.button === 2 && keyEls['MouseR']) keyEls['MouseR'].classList.remove('down');
    }
    // One listener pair on window (capture phase) — this already catches clicks
    // during pointer-locked gameplay. Registering on document too would double-
    // count every click (that was the "2 CPS per click" bug).
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', mouseDown, true);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', mouseUp, true);
    // safety: if focus is lost mid-hold, clear the held states
    window.addEventListener('blur', function () { if (keyEls['MouseL']) keyEls['MouseL'].classList.remove('down'); if (keyEls['MouseR']) keyEls['MouseR'].classList.remove('down'); });

    /* ============================================================
       HUD data bridge — reads the REAL game state that the native
       Java module (TreasureHud.java) publishes each tick to
       localStorage["_eaglercraft_1.12.tchud"]. Everything shown by
       Coordinates / Direction / Ping / Armor / Potions / Held Item
       comes from here, so nothing is ever fabricated: if the Java
       side hasn't reported a value (or reports active=0), the HUD
       shows a placeholder instead of a made-up number.
       ============================================================ */
    var HUD_KEY = '_eaglercraft_1.12.tchud';
    var hud = { active: false };
    function readHudBridge() {
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem(HUD_KEY);
        if (!raw) { hud = { active: false }; return; }
        var txt = b64decodeStr(raw);
        var o = {};
        txt.split('\n').forEach(function (ln) { var i = ln.indexOf('='); if (i > 0) o[ln.substring(0, i)] = ln.substring(i + 1); });
        hud = o; hud.active = (o.active === '1');
      } catch (e) { hud = { active: false }; }
    }
    function compass(yaw) {
      // Minecraft yaw: 0=south(+Z), 90=west(-X), 180=north(-Z), 270=east(+X)
      var dirs8 = ['S','SW','W','NW','N','NE','E','SE'];
      var idx = Math.round(yaw / 45) % 8; if (idx < 0) idx += 8;
      var card = dirs8[idx];
      var axis = { S:'+Z', W:'-X', N:'-Z', E:'+X', SW:'', NW:'', NE:'', SE:'' }[card] || '';
      return { card: card, axis: axis };
    }
    function fmtPrec(v) {
      var n = parseFloat(v); if (isNaN(n)) return '—';
      return (String(state.coordPrecision) === '0') ? String(Math.round(n)) : n.toFixed(1);
    }
    function updateDataHud() {
      if (state.coords) {
        if (hud.active) coordsEl.textContent = 'XYZ  ' + fmtPrec(hud.x) + '  ' + fmtPrec(hud.y) + '  ' + fmtPrec(hud.z);
        else coordsEl.textContent = 'XYZ  — — —';
      }
      if (state.direction) {
        if (hud.active && hud.yaw != null) {
          var c = compass(parseFloat(hud.yaw));
          dirEl.textContent = (state.dirMode === 'detailed' && c.axis) ? (c.card + ' (' + c.axis + ')') : c.card;
        } else dirEl.textContent = '—';
      }
      if (state.ping) {
        var p = hud.active ? parseInt(hud.ping, 10) : -1;
        pingEl.textContent = (p != null && p >= 0) ? (p + ' ms') : 'ping n/a';
      }
      if (state.armorStatus) renderArmor();
      if (state.potionEffects) renderPotions();
      if (state.heldItem) renderHeld();
      if (state.perfMonitor) renderPerfMon();
      if (state.sprintStatus) renderSprint();
      if (state.sneakStatus) renderSneak();
    }
    function barColor(frac) { return frac < 0.25 ? 'low' : ''; }
    function renderArmor() {
      var names = ['Helmet','Chest','Legs','Boots'];
      if (!hud.active || !hud.armor) { armorEl.innerHTML = '<div class="tc-armor-slot"><i>—</i></div>'; return; }
      var slots = hud.armor.split('~');
      var html = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        var s = slots[i] || '-';
        if (s === '-') { html += '<div class="tc-armor-slot"><b>' + names[i] + '</b><i style="color:var(--dim)">—</i></div>'; continue; }
        var parts = s.split('|'); var frac = parseFloat(parts[1]);
        var dur = (frac >= 0) ? Math.round(frac * 100) + '%' : '✓';
        html += '<div class="tc-armor-slot"><b>' + names[i] + '</b><i class="' + (frac >= 0 ? barColor(frac) : '') + '">' + dur + '</i></div>';
      }
      armorEl.innerHTML = html;
    }
    function renderPotions() {
      if (!hud.active || !hud.potions) { potionsEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      var rows = hud.potions.split('~').filter(Boolean);
      if (!rows.length) { potionsEl.innerHTML = ''; return; }
      potionsEl.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
        var p = r.split('|'); var name = p[0] || '?'; var amp = parseInt(p[1], 10) || 0; var secs = parseInt(p[2], 10) || 0;
        var lvl = amp > 0 ? ' ' + (amp + 1) : '';
        var mm = Math.floor(secs / 60), ss = secs % 60; var time = mm + ':' + (ss < 10 ? '0' : '') + ss;
        return '<div class="tc-potion-row"><span class="tc-potion-dot"></span><span>' + name + lvl + '</span><span style="color:var(--dim)">' + time + '</span></div>';
      }).join('');
    }
    function renderHeld() {
      if (!hud.active || !hud.held || hud.held === '-') { heldEl.textContent = '—'; return; }
      var p = hud.held.split('|'); var name = p[0] || '?'; var count = parseInt(p[1], 10) || 1; var frac = parseFloat(p[2]);
      var txt = name + (count > 1 ? ' ×' + count : '');
      if (frac >= 0) txt += '  ' + Math.round(frac * 100) + '%';
      heldEl.textContent = txt;
    }
    function renderSprint() {
      var on = (hud.sprintmode === 'toggled');
      sprintEl.textContent = 'Sprint [' + (on ? 'ON' : 'OFF') + ']';
    }
    function renderSneak() {
      var on = (hud.sneakmode === 'toggled');
      sneakEl.textContent = 'Sneak [' + (on ? 'ON' : 'OFF') + ']';
    }
    function renderPerfMon() {
      var pingTxt = (hud.active && parseInt(hud.ping, 10) >= 0) ? (parseInt(hud.ping, 10) + ' ms') : 'n/a';
      perfMonEl.innerHTML =
        '<div class="tc-pm-row"><span>FPS</span><span>' + fpsVal + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="tc-pm-row"><span>Frame</span><span>' + (fpsVal > 0 ? (1000 / fpsVal).toFixed(1) : '—') + ' ms</span></div>' +
        '<div class="tc-pm-row"><span>Ping</span><span>' + pingTxt + '</span></div>';
    }

    /* ---------- FPS graph (real recent history) ---------- */
    var fpsHistory = [];
    function drawFpsGraph() {
      var cv = document.getElementById('tc-fpsgraph-cv'); if (!cv) return;
      var ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); var W = cv.width, H = cv.height;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      if (!fpsHistory.length) return;
      var max = Math.max(60, Math.max.apply(null, fpsHistory));
      var css = getComputedStyle(root);
      var a1 = css.getPropertyValue('--a-1').trim() || '#ffd76b';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var i = 0; i < fpsHistory.length; i++) {
        var x = (i / (fpsHistory.length - 1 || 1)) * W;
        var y = H - (fpsHistory[i] / max) * (H - 2) - 1;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = a1; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.lineTo(0, H); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18; ctx.fillStyle = a1; ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    /* ---------- FPS (real: page rAF) + CPS + data-HUD readout loop ---------- */
    var frames = 0, lastFpsT = performance.now(), fpsVal = 0, lastData = 0, lastHudRead = 0, lastModePoll = 0;
    function loop(now) {
      frames++;
      if (now - lastFpsT >= 500) {
        fpsVal = Math.round(frames * 1000 / (now - lastFpsT)); frames = 0; lastFpsT = now;
        if (state.fps) fpsEl.textContent = fpsVal + ' FPS';
        var pf = $('#tc-perf-fps'); if (pf) pf.textContent = fpsVal; // REAL number in the perf panel
        fpsHistory.push(fpsVal); if (fpsHistory.length > 70) fpsHistory.shift();
        if (state.fpsGraph) drawFpsGraph();
      }
      while (clicks.length && now - clicks[0] > 1000) clicks.shift();
      if (state.cps) cpsEl.textContent = clicks.length + ' CPS';
      // read the Java HUD bridge ~5x/sec and refresh the data-driven readouts
      if (now - lastHudRead >= 200) { readHudBridge(); lastHudRead = now; applyHudVisibility(); }
      if (now - lastData >= 100) { updateDataHud(); lastData = now; }
      if (now - lastModePoll >= 300) { pollSharedMode(); lastModePoll = now; }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);

    /* ============================================================
       Keybind Manager — one capture system for every Treasure
       Client hotkey. Buttons carry data-bindkey="menu|sprintToggle
       |sneakToggle"; clicking one listens for the next key, checks
       for conflicts, and stores <name>KeyCode/<name>KeyLabel in
       state (the Mod Menu key stays in menuKeyCode/menuKeyLabel for
       backwards-compat). In-game the hotkeys flip the matching mod.
       ============================================================ */
    var BINDS = {
      menu:        { code: 'menuKeyCode',        label: 'menuKeyLabel' },
      zoom:        { code: 'zoomKeyCode',        label: 'zoomKeyLabel' },
      sprintToggle:{ code: 'sprintToggleKeyCode',label: 'sprintToggleKeyLabel' },
      sneakToggle: { code: 'sneakToggleKeyCode', label: 'sneakToggleKeyLabel' }
    };
    function labelFor(code) {
      if (!code) return 'Unbound';
      var map = { KeyA:'A',KeyB:'B',KeyC:'C',KeyD:'D',KeyE:'E',KeyF:'F',KeyG:'G',KeyH:'H',KeyI:'I',KeyJ:'J',KeyK:'K',KeyL:'L',KeyM:'M',KeyN:'N',KeyO:'O',KeyP:'P',KeyQ:'Q',KeyR:'R',KeyS:'S',KeyT:'T',KeyU:'U',KeyV:'V',KeyW:'W',KeyX:'X',KeyY:'Y',KeyZ:'Z', ShiftRight:'Right Shift', ShiftLeft:'Left Shift', ControlLeft:'Left Ctrl', ControlRight:'Right Ctrl', AltLeft:'Left Alt', AltRight:'Right Alt', Backslash:'\\', Backquote:'`', Minus:'-', Equal:'=', Tab:'Tab', BracketLeft:'[', BracketRight:']', Semicolon:';', Quote:"'", Comma:',', Period:'.', Slash:'/' };
      if (map[code]) return map[code];
      if (/^F([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-4])$/.test(code)) return code;
      if (/^Key([A-Z])$/.test(code)) return code.slice(3);
      if (/^Digit(\d)$/.test(code)) return code.slice(5);
      return code;
    }
    function isSafeMenuKey(code) {
      // The Mod Menu hotkey is captured in the capture phase and swallowed with
      // stopImmediatePropagation before the game sees it, so letters/numbers are
      // fine — you just can't bind it to a couple of keys that would trap you in
      // the menu (Escape closes it) or a modifier that fires constantly.
      if (['Escape'].indexOf(code) !== -1) return false;
      return true;
    }
    function bindConflict(name, code) {
      if (!code) return null;
      var hit = null;
      Object.keys(BINDS).forEach(function (n) { if (n !== name && state[BINDS[n].code] === code) hit = n; });
      return hit;
    }
    function refreshBindButtons() {
      $$('.tc-keybind[data-bindkey]').forEach(function (btn) {
        var name = btn.dataset.bindkey; var b = BINDS[name]; if (!b) return;
        btn.textContent = state[b.label] || labelFor(state[b.code]);
      });
    }
    var bindListening = null;
    $$('.tc-keybind[data-bindkey]').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        // cancel any other listening button
        $$('.tc-keybind.listening').forEach(function (o) { o.classList.remove('listening'); refreshBindButtons(); });
        bindListening = btn.dataset.bindkey;
        btn.classList.add('listening'); btn.textContent = 'Press a key…';
      });
    });
    function setBind(name, code) {
      var b = BINDS[name]; if (!b) return;
      // The Mod Menu key is required — refuse to clear it (only allow a real key).
      if (name === 'menu' && !code) return;
      state[b.code] = code; state[b.label] = labelFor(code);
      if (name === 'menu') { state.menuKeyCode = code; state.menuKeyLabel = labelFor(code); }
      save(); refreshBindButtons();
    }
    var kbWarn = $('#tc-kb-warn');
    function showBindWarn(msg) {
      // show in the Movement panel's inline warning if visible, but always also
      // surface a floating toast so rebinding from the Interface panel (or the
      // footer) gives feedback too.
      if (kbWarn) { kbWarn.textContent = msg || ''; if (msg) { clearTimeout(showBindWarn._t); showBindWarn._t = setTimeout(function () { kbWarn.textContent = ''; }, 2600); } }
      if (msg && typeof showModFlash === 'function') showModFlash(msg);
    }

    // GUARD: when the user is typing in one of the overlay's own text inputs
    // (search box, relay code fields, etc.), keep the keystrokes inside that
    // input and stop the game engine from capturing them as movement/hotkeys.
    // Without this the engine swallows the letters and you can't type. Runs in
    // capture phase before everything else. We DON'T stop the bind-capture flow.
    function tcIsTypingTarget(e) {
      var t = e.target;
      if (!t) return false;
      var tag = t.tagName;
      return (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || t.isContentEditable) && root.contains(t);
    }
    ['keydown', 'keyup', 'keypress'].forEach(function (evt) {
      window.addEventListener(evt, function (e) {
        // don't intercept while rebinding a key (that flow wants the raw event)
        if (bindListening) return;
        if (tcIsTypingTarget(e)) {
          // The key belongs to one of our text fields. We must NOT stopPropagation
          // in this window capture-phase listener — that would stop the event
          // before it descends to the input itself (the classic "can't type"
          // bug). Instead the input carries its own bubble-phase handlers that
          // stopImmediatePropagation to keep the key away from the game engine
          // once the input has processed it. Here we simply bow out.
          return;
        }
      }, true);
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (bindListening) {
        e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
        var name = bindListening; bindListening = null;
        $$('.tc-keybind.listening').forEach(function (o) { o.classList.remove('listening'); });
        if (e.code === 'Escape') { refreshBindButtons(); return; }
        if (name === 'menu' && !isSafeMenuKey(e.code)) {
          showBindWarn('That key clashes with movement/typing — pick another for the Mod Menu.');
          refreshBindButtons(); return;
        }
        var conflict = bindConflict(name, e.code);
        if (conflict) { showBindWarn('Already bound to “' + conflict + '”. Clear it first.'); refreshBindButtons(); return; }
        setBind(name, e.code);
        return;
      }
      // If the user is typing in one of our text fields, the key belongs to the
      // field — don't treat it as a hotkey (so e.g. a search containing the menu
      // key doesn't close the menu, and letters aren't eaten).
      if (tcIsTypingTarget(e)) return;
      // Mod Menu open/close
      if (state.menuKeyCode && e.code === state.menuKeyCode) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); toggleGui(); return; }
      if (e.code === 'Escape' && gui.classList.contains('open')) { e.preventDefault(); closeGui(); }
    }, true);

    function syncModToggleSwitch(key) {
      var sw = $('.tc-sw[data-mod="' + key + '"]'); if (sw) sw.classList.toggle('on', !!state[key]);
    }
    // tiny transient on-screen flash when a hotkey flips a mod
    var flashEl = null;
    function showModFlash(msg) {
      if (!flashEl) {
        flashEl = document.createElement('div');
        flashEl.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:50%;top:12%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2147483002;font:600 14px Outfit,sans-serif;color:var(--bg0);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--a-1),var(--a-2));padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px -8px var(--glow);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s;';
        root.appendChild(flashEl);
      }
      flashEl.textContent = msg; flashEl.style.opacity = '1';
      clearTimeout(showModFlash._t); showModFlash._t = setTimeout(function () { flashEl.style.opacity = '0'; }, 1100);
    }
    refreshBindButtons();

    /* ---------- Interface panel: clear / reset the Mod Menu key ---------- */
    (function () {
      var def = $('#tc-kb-default');
      // Note: the Mod Menu key can be CHANGED but never cleared — there's
      // deliberately no "clear" control for it, so the menu can always be reopened.
      if (def) def.addEventListener('click', function () { setBind('menu', 'ShiftRight'); });

    })();

    /* ---------- Custom HUD Editor (drag to reposition, persisted) ---------- */
    (function () {
      var editBtn = $('#tc-hud-edit'), bar = $('#tc-editbar'),
          resetBtn = $('#tc-eb-reset'), doneBtn = $('#tc-eb-done');
      var editing = false, drag = null;
      // which state flag enables each HUD element — edit mode only reveals the
      // ones the user actually has turned on (no phantom keystrokes/coords/etc.)
      var HUD_ENABLE = {
        'tc-coords':'coords', 'tc-direction':'direction', 'tc-ping':'ping',
        'tc-armor':'armorStatus', 'tc-potions':'potionEffects', 'tc-helditem':'heldItem',
        'tc-fpsgraph':'fpsGraph', 'tc-perfmon':'perfMonitor',
        'tc-keystrokes':'keystrokes', 'tc-cps':'cps', 'tc-fps':'fps'
      };
      function enabledHudEls() { return HUD_ELS.filter(function (id) { var k = HUD_ENABLE[id]; return k ? !!state[k] : false; }); }
      function enter() {
        editing = true; root.classList.add('hud-editing');
        // only reveal HUD elements that are currently enabled, so you reposition
        // exactly what you'll actually see — nothing you have switched off
        HUD_ELS.forEach(function (id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return;
          var k = HUD_ENABLE[id];
          if (k && state[k]) el.classList.remove('tc-hidden');
          else el.classList.add('tc-hidden');
        });
        bar.classList.remove('tc-hidden');
        // close just the Mod Menu panel — keep the overlay up so HUD boxes stay draggable
        gui.classList.remove('open'); root.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false'); if (root.__tcBgStop) root.__tcBgStop();
        // pause the game completely while editing: open the in-game menu so the world
        // freezes (singleplayer) and the mouse is released for dragging
        try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcpause', btoa(String.fromCharCode(1))); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (document.exitPointerLock) document.exitPointerLock(); } catch (e) {}
      }
      function exit() {
        editing = false; root.classList.remove('hud-editing');
        bar.classList.add('tc-hidden'); applyHud();
        // un-pause: close the in-game menu we opened for editing
        try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcpause', btoa(String.fromCharCode(2))); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (editBtn) editBtn.addEventListener('click', enter);
      if (doneBtn) doneBtn.addEventListener('click', exit);
      if (resetBtn) resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        state.hudPositions = {}; save();
        HUD_ELS.forEach(function (id) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) { el.style.left = el.style.top = el.style.right = el.style.bottom = el.style.transform = ''; } });
      });
      function down(e) {
        if (!editing) return;
        var t = e.target.closest('.tc-hud-box, #tc-potions, #tc-keystrokes, #tc-cps, #tc-fps');
        if (!t || !root.contains(t)) return;
        if (t.classList.contains('tc-hidden')) return; // don't drag a disabled (hidden) element
        e.preventDefault();
        var r = t.getBoundingClientRect();
        drag = { el: t, dx: e.clientX - r.left, dy: e.clientY - r.top };
        t.classList.add('tc-hud-drag-active');
      }
      function move(e) {
        if (!drag) return;
        var left = e.clientX - drag.dx, top = e.clientY - drag.dy;
        left = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 20, left));
        top = Math.max(0, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 20, top));
        drag.el.style.left = left + 'px'; drag.el.style.top = top + 'px';
        drag.el.style.right = 'auto'; drag.el.style.bottom = 'auto'; drag.el.style.transform = 'none';
      }
      function up() {
        if (!drag) return;
        var id = drag.el.id, r = drag.el.getBoundingClientRect();
        state.hudPositions = state.hudPositions || {};
        state.hudPositions[id] = { left: Math.round(r.left), top: Math.round(r.top) };
        save();
        drag.el.classList.remove('tc-hud-drag-active'); drag = null;
      }
      window.addEventListener('mousedown', down, true);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', move, true);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', up, true);
    })();


    // Apply & Reload — writes current perf options then reloads so the engine
    // Fullbright is the only engine graphics option we still touch; it's applied
    // via applyFullbrightToEngine() when toggled. A reload makes it take effect
    // immediately since the engine re-reads options at startup.
    (function () {
      // "Open Video Settings" — the overlay can't push the Java video screen
      // open directly, so we close the Mod Menu and tell the user where it is
      // (Options ▸ Video Settings). Fullbright still applies live on reload.
    })();

    /* ---------- Themes tab (select + custom title) ---------- */
    function activeTitle() {
      var t = tcTheme(state.theme);
      var c = state.themeTitles && state.themeTitles[state.theme];
      return (c && String(c).trim()) ? String(c).trim() : t.title;
    }
    function applyTitle() {
      var ov = state.themeTitles && state.themeTitles[state.theme];
      ov = (ov == null) ? '' : String(ov).trim();
      // Default: show the logo wordmark. If the user set a custom title for this
      // theme, show that text in its place instead.
      $$('.tc-brandwrap').forEach(function (w) {
        var img = w.querySelector('.tc-logo-word'), cu = w.querySelector('.tc-brand-custom');
        if (ov) { if (img) img.style.display = 'none'; if (cu) { cu.style.display = ''; cu.textContent = ov; } }
        else { if (img) img.style.display = ''; if (cu) { cu.style.display = 'none'; cu.textContent = ''; } }
      });
      // Publish a custom title for native/Java surfaces ONLY when the user set one;
      // otherwise clear it so the main menu keeps its default brand line.
      try {
        if (ov) localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tctitle', btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(ov))));
        else localStorage.removeItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tctitle');
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    /* ---------- Treasure Client logo artwork (provided by the user) ---------- */
    var TC_LOGO_CHEST = {normal:"data:image/png;base64,",frost:"data:image/png;base64,",tropical:"data:image/png;base64,",terracotta:"data:image/png;base64,",forest:"data:image/png;base64,"};
    var TC_LOGO_WORD = {normal:"data:image/png;base64,",frost:"data:image/png;base64,",tropical:"data:image/png;base64,",terracotta:"data:image/png;base64,",forest:"data:image/png;base64,"};
    var TC_FAV = "data:image/png;base64,";
    function tcApplyLogos() {
      try {
        var th = (state && state.theme) || 'normal';
        var c = TC_LOGO_CHEST[th] || TC_LOGO_CHEST.normal;
        var w = TC_LOGO_WORD[th] || TC_LOGO_WORD.normal;
        $$('.tc-logo-chest').forEach(function (i) { i.src = c; });
        $$('.tc-logo-word').forEach(function (i) { i.src = w; });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function tcUpdateFavicon() {
      try {
        var link = document.querySelector('link[rel~="icon"]');
        if (!link) { link = document.createElement('link'); link.setAttribute('rel', 'icon'); document.head.appendChild(link); }
        link.setAttribute('type', 'image/png');
        link.setAttribute('href', TC_FAV);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    try { document.title = 'Treasure Client 1.12 WASM'; } catch (e) {}
    function applyTheme(id) {
      var t = tcTheme(id); state.theme = t.id;
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', t.id);
      tcUpdateFavicon();
      tcApplyLogos(); // recolor the header logo to match the theme
      tcRefreshMenuBg(); // out-of-game Mod Menu shows the active theme's background
      $$('.tc-theme').forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle('selected', c.dataset.themeId === t.id); });
      applyTitle();
      try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tctheme', btoa(t.id)); } catch (e) {}
      if (root.__tcBgReseed) root.__tcBgReseed();
    }
    function themeThumb(t) {
      if (t.bgs && t.bgs.length) { var i = (state.themeBg && state.themeBg[t.id]) || 0; return t.bgs[i] || t.bgs[0]; }
      return t.bg;
    }
    // Treasure Client: the Java side writes tcinworld=1 while in a world, so the
    // Mod Menu paints the active theme's background ONLY from the main menu (never
    // in-game, where the paused world shows through unchanged).
    function tcInWorld() {
      try {
        var r = localStorage.getItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcinworld');
        if (!r) return false;
        var b = atob(r);
        return b.length > 0 && b.charCodeAt(0) === 1;
      } catch (e) { return false; }
    }
    function tcRefreshMenuBg() {
      try {
        var img = $('#tc-gui-img'); if (!img) return;
        if (gui.classList.contains('open') && !tcInWorld()) {
          var src = themeThumb(tcTheme(state.theme));
          img.style.backgroundImage = src ? ('url(' + src + ')') : '';
          img.style.opacity = src ? '1' : '';
        } else {
          img.style.backgroundImage = '';
          img.style.opacity = '';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    function updateCardThumb(id) {
      var card = $('.tc-theme[data-theme-id="' + id + '"]'); if (!card) return;
      var th = card.querySelector('.tc-theme-thumb'); if (!th) return;
      var src = themeThumb(tcTheme(id));
      th.style.backgroundImage = src ? ('url(' + src + ')') : '';
    }
    (function buildThemeCards() {
      var wrap = $('#tc-themes'); if (!wrap) return;
      wrap.innerHTML = TC_THEMES.map(function (t) {
        var tbg = themeThumb(t);
        var thumb = tbg ? ('background-image:url(' + tbg + ')') : 'background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a-3),var(--bg0))';
        return '<div class="tc-theme" data-theme-id="' + t.id + '" title="Left-click: apply   Right-click: settings">' +
                 '<div class="tc-theme-thumb" style="' + thumb + '"></div>' +
                 '<div class="tc-theme-foot"><span class="tc-theme-name"></span><span class="tc-theme-tag">Selected</span></div>' +
               '</div>';
      }).join('');
      $$('.tc-theme').forEach(function (card) {
        var th = tcTheme(card.dataset.themeId);
        var nm = card.querySelector('.tc-theme-name'); if (nm) nm.textContent = th.name;
        card.addEventListener('click', function () { applyTheme(card.dataset.themeId); save(); });
        card.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); openTitleEditor(card.dataset.themeId); });
      });
    })();
    var teWrap = $('#tc-title-editor'), teInput = $('#tc-te-input'), teName = $('#tc-te-theme'), teEditing = null;
    function openTitleEditor(id) {
      var t = tcTheme(id); teEditing = id;
      if (teName) teName.textContent = t.name;
      if (teInput) {
        var cur = state.themeTitles && state.themeTitles[id];
        teInput.value = (cur != null && cur !== '') ? cur : t.title;
        teInput.placeholder = t.title;
      }
      // background chooser — only for themes that ship more than one background
      var bgrow = $('#tc-te-bgrow'), bgs = $('#tc-te-bgs');
      if (bgrow && bgs) {
        if (t.bgs && t.bgs.length > 1) {
          var sel = (state.themeBg && state.themeBg[id]) || 0;
          bgs.innerHTML = t.bgs.map(function (b, i) {
            return '<button class="tc-bgopt' + (i === sel ? ' sel' : '') + '" data-bgi="' + i + '" style="background-image:url(' + b + ')"></button>';
          }).join('');
          $$('.tc-bgopt', bgs).forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
              ev.stopPropagation();
              var i = parseInt(btn.dataset.bgi, 10) || 0;
              if (!state.themeBg) state.themeBg = {};
              state.themeBg[id] = i; save();
              $$('.tc-bgopt', bgs).forEach(function (o) { o.classList.toggle('sel', o === btn); });
              updateCardThumb(id);
              if (id === state.theme) { try { localStorage.setItem('_eaglercraft_1.12.tcbg', btoa(String(i))); } catch (x) {} }
            });
          });
          bgrow.style.display = '';
        } else { bgs.innerHTML = ''; bgrow.style.display = 'none'; }
      }
      if (teWrap) teWrap.classList.add('open');
      try { teInput.focus(); teInput.select(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    function closeTitleEditor() { if (teWrap) teWrap.classList.remove('open'); teEditing = null; }
    function saveTitleEditor() {
      if (teEditing == null) return;
      var v = (teInput ? teInput.value : '').trim();
      if (!state.themeTitles) state.themeTitles = {};
      if (v) state.themeTitles[teEditing] = v; else delete state.themeTitles[teEditing];
      save();
      if (teEditing === state.theme) applyTitle();
      closeTitleEditor();
    }
    if ($('#tc-te-save')) $('#tc-te-save').addEventListener('click', saveTitleEditor);
    if ($('#tc-te-cancel')) $('#tc-te-cancel').addEventListener('click', closeTitleEditor);
    if ($('#tc-te-reset')) $('#tc-te-reset').addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (teEditing == null) return;
      if (state.themeTitles) delete state.themeTitles[teEditing];
      if (teInput) teInput.value = tcTheme(teEditing).title;
      save();
      if (teEditing === state.theme) applyTitle();
    });
    if (teInput) {
      ['keydown','keyup','keypress'].forEach(function (evt) {
        teInput.addEventListener(evt, function (e) {
          e.stopPropagation(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
          if (evt === 'keydown' && e.key === 'Enter') saveTitleEditor();
          if (evt === 'keydown' && e.key === 'Escape') closeTitleEditor();
        }, false);
      });
      teInput.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
      teInput.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); try { teInput.focus(); } catch (x) {} }, false);
    }

    /* ---------- init ---------- */
    tcApplyLogos();
    applyMode(); applyHud();
    applyFullbrightToEngine(); // only writes the Fullbright gamma option
    applyResolutionScale();    // write the render-resolution scale for PlatformInput
    writeModsToEngine(); // write toggle-sprint/sneak/hitbox flags for the native Java module

    /* ---------- animated ClickGUI background (gold rain / flowing water) ---------- */
    (function () {
      var cv = document.getElementById('tc-gui-bg');
      if (!cv) return;
      var ctx = cv.getContext('2d'), W = 0, H = 0, raf = null, parts = [], last = 0;
      var reduce = false;
      try { reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; } catch (e) {}
      // Frost weather: eased wind + snow intensity, re-aimed on a natural timer so
      // it drifts between calm snowfall and gusty wind (never both at full tilt).
      var wind = 0, windTarget = 0, snow = 1, snowTarget = 1, nextShift = 0;
      function size() { W = cv.clientWidth || cv.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth; H = cv.clientHeight || cv.offsetHeight || window.innerHeight; cv.width = W; cv.height = H; }
      function coin(any) { return { x: Math.random()*W, y: any?Math.random()*H:-20, r: 2+Math.random()*3, vy: 22+Math.random()*40, vx: -6+Math.random()*12, sp: Math.random()*Math.PI, vs: (-1+Math.random()*2)*1.1 }; }
      function flake(any) { return { x: Math.random()*W, y: any?Math.random()*H:-10, r: 0.6+Math.random()*1.5, vy: 14+Math.random()*34, ph: Math.random()*Math.PI*2, sw: 0.4+Math.random()*1.0, o: 0.35+Math.random()*0.5 }; }
      function bubble(any) { return { x: Math.random()*W, y: any?Math.random()*H:H+8, r: 1.5+Math.random()*3.0, vy: 10+Math.random()*20, w: Math.random()*Math.PI*2, vw: 0.4+Math.random()*0.7, a: 6+Math.random()*12 }; }
      function pickWeather() {
        if (Math.random() < 0.5) { windTarget = (Math.random()<0.5?-1:1) * (0.55+Math.random()*0.45); snowTarget = 0.35+Math.random()*0.3; }
        else { windTarget = -0.12+Math.random()*0.24; snowTarget = 0.85+Math.random()*0.45; }
        nextShift = performance.now() + 6000 + Math.random()*7000;
      }
      function seed() {
        parts = [];
        if (state.theme === 'frost') { for (var i = 0; i < 90; i++) parts.push(flake(true)); pickWeather(); wind = windTarget; snow = snowTarget; }
        else if (state.theme === 'tropical') { for (var tb = 0; tb < 42; tb++) parts.push(bubble(true)); }
        else if (state.theme === 'terracotta') { for (var tt = 0; tt < 44; tt++) parts.push(bubble(true)); }
        else if (state.theme === 'forest') { for (var fo = 0; fo < 44; fo++) parts.push(bubble(true)); }
        else { for (var j = 0; j < 60; j++) parts.push(coin(true)); }
      }
      function frame(t) {
        var dt = Math.min(0.05, (t-last)/1000) || 0; last = t;
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
        if (state.theme === 'frost') {
          if (t > nextShift) pickWeather();
          var ease = Math.min(1, dt*0.6);
          wind += (windTarget - wind) * ease;
          snow += (snowTarget - snow) * ease;
          var gust = wind * 150, aw = Math.abs(wind), vis = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, snow));
          if (aw > 0.22) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(214,238,255,' + (0.04 + aw*0.07).toFixed(3) + ')';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            for (var s = 0; s < 7; s++) {
              var sy = (H * (s + 0.5) / 7) + Math.sin(t*0.0006 + s)*14;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, sy);
              for (var sx = 0; sx <= W; sx += 46) ctx.lineTo(sx, sy + Math.sin(sx*0.015 + t*0.002 + s)*3*aw);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
          var shown = Math.floor(parts.length * (0.3 + 0.7*vis));
          for (var i=0;i<parts.length;i++){
            var f=parts[i];
            f.ph += dt*2.2; f.y += f.vy*dt;
            f.x += (Math.sin(f.ph)*f.sw*8)*dt + gust*f.sw*0.14*dt;
            if (f.y > H+6 || f.x < -16 || f.x > W+16) { parts[i] = flake(false); if (wind > 0.2) parts[i].x = -12; else if (wind < -0.2) parts[i].x = W+12; continue; }
            if (i > shown) continue;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, 6.283);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,250,255,' + (f.o*(0.4+0.6*vis)).toFixed(3) + ')';
            ctx.fill();
          }
        } else if (state.theme === 'tropical') {
          for (var bi=0;bi<parts.length;bi++){ var p=parts[bi]; p.y-=p.vy*dt; p.w+=p.vw*dt; var bx=p.x+Math.sin(p.w)*p.a; if(p.y<-8){parts[bi]=bubble(false);continue;} ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx,p.y,p.r,0,6.283); ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,235,215,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.stroke(); }
        } else if (state.theme === 'terracotta') {
          for (var ti=0;ti<parts.length;ti++){ var q=parts[ti]; q.y+=q.vy*dt; q.w+=q.vw*dt; var qx=q.x+Math.sin(q.w)*q.a; if(q.y>H+8){q.y=-8;q.x=Math.random()*W;} ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(qx,q.y,q.r*0.85,0,6.283); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(230,150,80,0.5)'; ctx.fill(); }
        } else if (state.theme === 'forest') {
          for (var gi=0;gi<parts.length;gi++){ var r=parts[gi]; r.y-=r.vy*dt; r.w+=r.vw*dt; var rx=r.x+Math.sin(r.w)*r.a; if(r.y<-8){r.y=H+8;r.x=Math.random()*W;} ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(rx,r.y,r.r*0.8,0,6.283); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,220,120,0.55)'; ctx.fill(); }
        } else {
          for (var k=0;k<parts.length;k++){ var c=parts[k]; c.y+=c.vy*dt; c.x+=c.vx*dt; c.sp+=c.vs*dt; if(c.y>H+20){parts[k]=coin(false);continue;} var wob=Math.abs(Math.cos(c.sp)); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(c.x,c.y); var grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-c.r,0,c.r); grd.addColorStop(0,'#fff3c4'); grd.addColorStop(0.5,'#e6b93f'); grd.addColorStop(1,'#8a5a20'); ctx.fillStyle=grd; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,c.r*(0.35+0.65*wob),c.r,0,0,6.283); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }
        }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
      function start() { if (reduce) { size(); seed(); ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); return; } if (!raf) { size(); seed(); last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame); } }
      function stop() { if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = null; } }
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if (raf) { size(); seed(); } });
      root.__tcBgStart = function () { size(); seed(); start(); };
      root.__tcBgStop = stop;
      root.__tcBgReseed = function () { if (raf) { seed(); } };
    })();

    // (mode change hooks removed — Deep Sea mode no longer exists)

    console.log('[TreasureClient] overlay ready — press', state.menuKeyLabel, 'to open.');
  }
})();

</script>

<div style="margin:0px;width:100%;height:100%;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;user-select:none;" id="launch_countdown_screen">
<div style="margin:auto;text-align:center;">
<h1>This file is from <span style="color:#AA0000;">${date}</span></h1>
<h2>Game will launch in <span id="launchCountdownNumber">5</span>...</h2>
<div style="border:2px solid black;width:100%;height:15px;padding:1px;margin-bottom:20vh;"><div id="launchCountdownProgress" style="background-color:#555555;width:0%;height:100%;"></div>
<p style="margin-top:30px;"><button id="skipCountdown" autofocus>Skip Countdown</button></p></div>
</div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
